notes:
Qualification summary: EU-regulated fintech focusing on AML/KYC automation and regulatory summarization. Interested in private VPC deployment with a small on-prem footprint for the most sensitive workloads. Primary ask: proof of KMS/HSM integration, full audit logging to their SIEM, and strict data residency in eu-west-1/eu-central-1.

Call highlights (2026-02-28):
- CTO (Marta Rossi): "cannot have customer PII leave EU boundary under any circumstance."
- Security: needs full packet flow diagram + egress controls; prefers PrivateLink or Transit Gateway model; NAT-only egress for batch telemetry.
- Infra: latency target p95 <= 60ms for chat (short prompts), baseline throughput 120 req/s for support-agent workload, peak burst to 400 req/s planned.

Technical constraints / asks:
- VPC topology: prefer model where Redwood control plane endpoints are reachable via PrivateLink; inference plane placed into customer-managed subnets (private subnets across AZs) with dedicated ENIs.
- Inbound/outbound: no public inbound, all management traffic via customer bastion + mutual TLS; outbound only to specific S3 endpoints and Redwood telemetry endpoints via VPC endpoints.
- KMS: bring-your-own-key mandatory for stored artifacts, key rotation policy required; HSM attestation desirable for signing inference logs.
- Audit logging: full token-level audit events shipped to their SIEM (Splunk) with 365-day retention; support for immutable audit archives.

Sales notes / tone: high buyer intent. Legal has flagged two clauses re: data processing addendum and subprocessor list. Procurement budget allocated; looking for vendor SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence. POC scope agreed: 3-week POC (search + chat) with KMS test and synthetic load up to 200 req/s.

Stated risks: if KMS integration delays >2 weeks, they'll consider building internally on managed Kubernetes. Competitive pressure from internal infra and big-cloud managed endpoints.

Action items captured: AP Jordan to deliver network checklist + sample VPC template by 2026-03-12; SE Sofia to prep KMS integration runbook and IaC snippets; legal to get DPA redline from Hawthorn counsel by 2026-03-20.

architecture_fit_summary: Good fit for Redwood Private: customer's topology maps to Redwood's recommended model where inference nodes live in customer VPC private subnets, management plane uses PrivateLink endpoints, and audit logs are forwarded to customer SIEM. Main integration points: (1) KMS/BYOK for artifact encryption and model key wrap, (2) VPC endpoints for S3/SQS and secure egress, (3) optional on-prem gateway for air-gapped seeds. Region constraint: must operate in eu-west-1 or eu-central-1; Redwood can provision regional inference clusters and apply routing policies to ensure residency. Proposed topology: three AZ private subnets for inference, dedicated management ENIs, NAT Gateway restricted to allowed endpoints, and Transit/PrivateLink peering for control plane. Expect one 3-week POC to validate latency and KMS flows.
